turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to set up the new GPU cluster for the LLM benchmarks. Do you have the driver version notes handy?
I can help with that. The recommended driver version for your setup is 535.104.05. Did you run into any specific compatibility issues?
Yeah, just a minor conflict with the CUDA toolkit. Also, I need to coordinate the rollout. Ashok Chandrasekar is the SIG lead for llm-d benchmarking, so I'll loop him in for the sign-off.
Noted. I've added a reminder to follow up with Ashok Chandrasekar once the drivers are stable. Have you checked the power consumption logs yet?
Not yet, the fans are pretty loud today. It's actually quite warm outside, probably why the cooling is struggling a bit.
That could definitely contribute. I suggest checking the thermal paste application if the temps stay high. Would you like me to order some new thermal pads?
No, I have some spare ones. Let's focus on getting the benchmark suite running first. Thanks for the help.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need assistance with the benchmark scripts.
